## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Fold `RequestInput` into `HandleDeferredToolCalls`, whose handler can take a resume token by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13285
* Support Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen`) on `GoogleModel` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13299
* Generalize response-scoped tool call IDs into the `tool_call_ids_are_response_scoped` profile flag by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13128
* Add `service_tier` support to `GroqModel` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13521
* Detect loops in streamed thinking, text and tool call arguments in `DetectLoops` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/12222
* Make `Advisor` accept `native=` and `local=` like the other `NativeOrLocalTool` capabilities, deprecating `mode` by @adtyavrdhn in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/13149
* Treat nested CodeMode `ToolFailed` calls as failed results by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://githu
